method: Retrieved each file at the immutable commit ref, flattened Techniques[].Steps[], parsed and sorted SubStep by numeric major step, branch letter, numeric suborder, then compared ordered (SubStep, TechniqueId) pairs.

summary.interpretation: Source reconstruction consistency only. Five vendor exports are views of the same MITRE-designed emulation, not five independent campaigns; this does not validate model metrics.

hash_note: The listed values are Git blob SHA-1 object IDs reported for the source files, not SHA-256 file hashes. The benchmark computes SHA-256 hashes for the actual local input bytes at run time.
